messages:
Zoe (platform): Heads up — we're seeing tail latency spikes when the gateway tries to push spans to multiple exporters under soft egress throttles. Seems like exporter ack backlog causes agent TCP sessions to pile up and then everything stalls.
Mike (infra): Ugh. Is this the per-signal pipeline we flipped last week?
Zoe (platform): Yep. We moved to separate pipelines for traces vs metrics, and split exporters by tenant tier. Under constrained egress the gateway is dropping or delaying acks which cascades back.
Anita (eng-runtime): Do we have visibility into ack rates vs queue depth? Suggest adding exporter_ack_rate and exporter_pending_batches as console metrics.
Zoe (platform): I ran a quick grep in the traces: gateway returns 503 occasionally and agent keeps resending same batch until ack, which inflates KV cache. snippet: ```otlp_exporter:
  endpoint: https://exporter.foo
  retries: 5
  ack_strategy: blocking
```
Samir (sre): If ack_strategy=blocking we block the pipeline thread — not ideal. Can we switch to ack_strategy=async + acks-with-window to avoid head-of-line blocking?
Anita (eng-runtime): Proposal: gateway sends lightweight ack token with sequence + window_size. Agent keeps in-memory window per exporter and only retries outside window. That way slow exporter doesn't block distinct exporters or downstream collectors.
Mike (infra): OK but two risks: 1) memory blowup per-tenant if they hammer, 2) ordering semantics for spans if we drop in-window retries. We should define soft quotas.
Zoe (platform): On memory: use a bounded ring buffer + disk-backed overflow for non-critical tenants. For ordering: maintain sequence per-tenant/stream and allow reordering within a small window but mark as degraded in trace metadata. We can surface that in the console.
Samir (sre): For the console UX, add per-tenant egress_lag, exporter_ack_lag, kv_cache_eviction_rate. Alert when ack_lag > 5s and pending_batches > 100.
Anita (eng-runtime): Implementation sketch: ```
# simplified pseudo
on_send(batch): seq = next_seq()
  send(batch, meta={seq, tenant, window_len})
on_ack(meta): mark_seq_ack(meta.seq)
retransmit(): only retransmit seq < tail_ack - window_len
```
Zoe (platform): Also want exporter prioritization: critical exporters (sys-logs, billing) get higher window and fast-retry; lower-priority ones get lossy mode (no retries, best-effort). Could be per-tenant override.
Mike (infra): That maps to routing policies. We need API fields for `exporter_priority` and `exporter_mode` (lossy|best-effort|guaranteed). Add to collector manifest.
Samir (sre): And retention: for lossy exporters we can keep longer in gateway disk buffer for a short TTL (30m) before dropping. That buys time during temporary egress outages.
Zoe (platform): One more: telemetry sampling/eviction policy should prefer dropping low-value spans first. We can piggyback sampling weight from the agent (sdk) or do heuristic on gateway.
Anita (eng-runtime): I'll prototype ack-windowing in a branch and wire exporter_priority into the pipeline. Will also add compatibility test with existing agent control plane.
Zoe (platform): Thanks — ticketed as: infra/collector#423. Assign Anita. Anyone object to disk-backed overflow for non-critical tenants? :thinking:
Mike (infra): :+1: disk overflow ok with quota checks. Add egress_cost_meter so finance can correlate.
Samir (sre): I'll draft alerts and dashboard panels.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for staging/collector-runtime v2.7.3 — canary tomorrow 08:00 UTC.
Zoe (platform): Cool. Follow-ups: Anita will push prototype PR, Samir will add dashboards, Mike will add API fields. We'll validate in staging and run a synthetic overload test. :thumbsup:
